prompt:
SHOT: medium shot, eye level, camera locked off, 35mm lens, as in the start frame.
ACTION: the man with short sandy hair receding at the temples, clean-shaven, wearing a dark grey suit jacket, has just been about to leave; he stops, his eyes fix on the monitor in front of him, he leans in slightly and freezes, mouth closed. He says nothing at all.
SCENE: an open-plan bank office in the early evening, empty desks, dusk in the windows, cool monitor light and a warm desk lamp.
RULES: Silent take, no speech, mouth closed the whole time, only quiet office room tone and a computer fan. Steady camera, same framing for the whole take. He never looks into the lens.

lint.msg: monitor: models invent letters on anything readable. Turn it away, keep it blurred, add real text in the edit.
